images.caption: Panorama of 2 miles of the riverfront of Cincinnati, Ohio, consisting of 8 full plate daguerreotypes.  Taken from a rooftop in Newport, Kentucky.  It is the largest daguerreotype scene of its age, and the oldest surviving example of a North American cityscape.
